entry: Local native engineering input *.vstate, with optional baseInput read through the existing mounted-root project loader. Scope, schema versions and release rules are selected by the actual decoder.
grid: Explicit numerical shape/encoding (f32 or f64), separately read x-fastest little-endian data, optional uint8 validity mask, word-exact step columns or unmasked f32 fractional affine and divisions, and at least one explicit stored-scalar view. Preserves masked and unmasked nonfinite and signed-zero words. Finite numerical view eligibility is separate. The current grid is distinct from an EB archival observation and from a physical Field.
layer: Complete ordered population resolved against the actual installed phase/frame/source-entity definitions. Owner locators resolve once in the same private snapshot as both independent target bindings, effective matrix and translation. The evaluated words are an explicitly supplied working state. No old native selector is re-evaluated to infer those words or physical placement.
thermal: Explicit native compatibility slots for an installed phase or molecule frame. The slots follow the complete current site or atom population in source order. Every independent raw flag and scalar plus six coefficients are retained, with no SG or native unit conversion.
legacyView: Explicit independent current scene matrix and four native view settings, preserving exact f64 and f32 words in the existing cameraRaw map.
references: Input locators are bounded array addresses into the mounted project and never survive as authority in the resulting source object. Independent resource keys and generated live typed relationships survive complete native artifact save through one fresh identity map. Existing Source7 object and host FrozenSave protocols stay unchanged.
mask: Mask is a distinct logical resource and has its own descriptor. Raw buffers and closed numerical frames are terminal reference rules for this adapter. An opaque capture still requires its own independent dependency rule.
legacyDisplay: Supply complete scene slots, four lights and current target values, plus the root-mounted old VICS source. With currentValues omitted or false, the compatibility reader applies supported source display assignments once. An explicit legacyView supplies current view words separately. With currentValues true, require an explicit legacyView and install the supplied display values without replaying source assignments. This input provides Draft working state regardless of historical producer qualification. Exact original records remain mounted as independent scene source history.
nativeFlags: The R80 import supplies the authenticated source and phase. Explicit current origin-image flags are separate from original lists. Optional selectedObjects defines an actual six-halfspace Cartesian box and selects a face, bond or polyhedron from the derived complete current P1 population. Native archival ordinals remain source observations.
moleculeFlags: Resolve each [frame,index] only against the actual declared nonperiodic molecule, its frame atom IDs and same-frame bonds. The current label and disabled selections preserve typed identities across artifact reopen.
vicsHistoricalInput: The direct selected .vcs reader reconstructs exact historic source phase and boundary observations from retained original records, preserving their explicit symmetry operators and site uncertainties separately. It does not claim old application constructor state or project unsupported historical bond/thermal conventions.
